criteria.description: Institution-and-field cells with at least 80 research doctorates over 2015-2022, at or above 70% non-resident in at least 6 separate years.

honest_reading: These cases show composition -- who received the degrees -- in programs supported by federal research funding. They do not show displacement. Over the same period total core-STEM doctorates and DOMESTIC core-STEM doctorates both rose by roughly a third, and master's awards more than doubled. Seats were not fixed and domestic participation did not fall.

department.note: Lists current doctoral students by name with their project and advisor. The department states it has grown to 30 doctoral students. This is current enrolment, not the 2015–2022 cohort the figure measures.
